transcript.text:
Here's the full sequence of API calls to create a source and trigger an account aggregation.

---

## Step 1: Get an Access Token

Use the Client Credentials grant flow (ideal for scripts/integrations):

```bash
POST https://[tenant].api.identitynow.com/oauth/token
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

grant_type=client_credentials&client_id={clientId}&client_secret={clientSecret}
```

The response contains `access_token`. Use it as `Authorization: Bearer {access_token}` on all subsequent calls.

---

## Step 2: Create the Source

The docs require: **name**, **description**, **owner**, and **connector** (connection type).

```bash
POST https://[tenant].api.identitynow.com/v3/sources
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "name": "My Example Source",
  "description": "Connected via API",
  "owner": {
    "type": "IDENTITY",
    "id": "{ownerIdentityId}",
    "name": "{ownerDisplayName}"
  },
  "connector": "active-directory",
  "connectorAttributes": {
    "IQServiceHost": "iqservice.example.com",
    "IQServicePort": "5050",
    "forest": "example.com",
    "user": "svc-sailpoint",
    "password": "secret"
  }
}
```

Capture the `id` field from the response — that's your `{sourceId}` for the next call.

---

## Step 3: Trigger Account Aggregation

```bash
POST https://[tenant].api.identitynow.com/beta/sources/{sourceId}/load-accounts
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "disableOptimization": false
}
```

- `disableOptimization: false` (default) means ISC only processes delta changes from the last aggregation — fine for initial runs too.
- Set `disableOptimization: true` to force a full re-import of all accounts.

For **flat file (CSV) sources**, you upload the file instead:

```bash
POST https://[tenant].api.identitynow.com/beta/sources/{sourceId}/load-accounts
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
Content-Type: multipart/form-data

file=@accounts.csv
```

The response returns a task object with a task `id` you can poll to check aggregation status.

---

## Optional Follow-ups

Before aggregation will correlate accounts to identities correctly, you may also want to:

- **`PUT /v3/sources/{id}/schemas/{schemaId}`** — define which account attributes to import.
- **`PUT /v3/sources/{id}/correlationConfig`** — map source account attributes to identity attributes for correlation.

These can be configured in the UI or via API before running the aggregation.

```answer-summary
endpoints:
  - method: POST
    path: /oauth/token
    api_version: oauth
  - method: POST
    path: /v3/sources
    api_version: v3
  - method: POST
    path: /beta/sources/{sourceId}/load-accounts
    api_version: beta
auth_flow: OAuth2 bearer token (client credentials grant)
required_scopes: []
key_parameters: [grant_type, client_id, client_secret, name, description, owner, connector, connectorAttributes, disableOptimization]
```
